title: MLflow evaluation dataset record (Databricks MLflow 3 schema)
description: One record of an MLflow evaluation dataset, as authored by the tool. Only `inputs` is required. Optional sections that are blank must be omitted entirely (no empty strings, lists or objects). Fields that MLflow assigns itself (dataset_record_id, create_time, created_by, last_update_time, last_updated_by) are not authored and are rejected here. A dataset file is a JSON array of these records.

inputs.description: Inputs for the app under evaluation, as arbitrary JSON keys (typically `question`).

expectations.description: Ground-truth labels. Reserved keys are read by built-in judges and scorers; other keys are allowed by MLflow and are kept as-is.

expected_facts.description: Read by the Correctness judge. Facts that must appear in a correct answer. List only facts that are strictly required.

expected_response.description: Read by the Correctness judge. The exact or similar expected output.

guidelines.description: Read by the Guidelines judge. Natural-language rules the answer must follow.

expected_retrieved_context.description: Read by the document_recall scorer. Documents or passages that should be retrieved.

tags.description: Key-value tags for the record. Any JSON value is allowed.

source.description: Where the record came from: exactly one of human, document, or trace.

doc_uri.description: Unique identifier (URI or path) of the source document.

content.description: The retrieved passage, entered as Markdown.
